description: Fetch one Law Commission of England & Wales publication (a consultation paper, report, summary or terms-of-reference) by its id (from search_law_commission_publications) or its lawcom.gov.uk link. Returns the law-reform project it belongs to and links to any attached PDF documents — the actual report text is the PDF; the WordPress record itself typically carries only a project link, not report prose.

link.description: A lawcom.gov.uk/publication/... link, as an alternative to id.

name: get_law_commission_publication
title: Get Law Commission Publication
